css: .t4-shell{font:13px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;color:#172033;background:#f8f9fb;border:1px solid #dfe3ea;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%}.t4-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:16px 18px 12px}.t4-head p{margin:0;color:#6c7688;font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em}.t4-head h2{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:21px}.t4-mode{font-size:11px;border:1px solid #ccd5e5;background:#edf2fb;color:#304f9f;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 8px}.t4-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:4px;padding:0 18px;border-bottom:1px solid #dfe3ea}.t4-tabs button{appearance:none;border:0;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;background:transparent;padding:10px 8px 9px;font:inherit;font-weight:700;color:#667186;cursor:pointer}.t4-tabs button.is-on{color:#2447bd;border-bottom-color:#3457d5}.t4-content{padding:16px 18px;min-height:175px;background:white}.t4-content h3{margin:0 0 9px;font-size:16px}.t4-content p{margin:0 0 8px;color:#596579}.t4-list{display:grid;gap:7px}.t4-task{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto auto;gap:9px;align-items:center;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid #e1e5ec;border-radius:9px}.t4-task strong{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.t4-task span{font-size:11px;color:#667186}.t4-pill{border-radius:999px!important;background:#eef1f5;padding:3px 7px}.t4-note{padding:10px;border-left:3px solid #3457d5;background:#f4f7fd;border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;white-space:pre-wrap}.t4-empty{color:#7b8494;font-style:italic}
js: const nameEl=root.querySelector('[data-project-name]');const content=root.querySelector('[data-content]');const tabs=[...root.querySelectorAll('[data-section]')];function activeProject(){const projects=api.getState('projects')||[];const id=api.getState('activeProjectId');return projects.find(p=>p.id===id)||projects[0]||null;}function noteValues(project){const notes=api.getState('notes');if(!notes)return[];if(Array.isArray(notes))return notes.filter(n=>!project||!n.projectId||n.projectId===project.id).map(n=>typeof n==='string'?n:(n.text||n.body||JSON.stringify(n)));if(typeof notes==='object'&&project){const v=notes[project.id]??notes[project.name]??notes[project.title];if(Array.isArray(v))return v.map(n=>typeof n==='string'?n:(n.text||n.body||JSON.stringify(n)));if(v!=null)return[typeof v==='string'?v:JSON.stringify(v)];}if(typeof notes==='string')return[notes];return[];}function section(){const s=api.getState('workspaceSection');return ['Overview','Tasks','Notes'].includes(s)?s:'Overview';}function render(){const project=activeProject();const sec=section();nameEl.textContent=project?(project.name||project.title||project.id):'No active project';tabs.forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('is-on',b.dataset.section===sec));content.replaceChildren();const h=document.createElement('h3');h.textContent=sec;content.append(h);if(sec==='Overview'){const tasks=api.getState('tasks')||[];const open=tasks.filter(t=>t.status!=='Done').length;const done=tasks.filter(t=>t.status==='Done').length;const p=document.createElement('p');p.textContent=project?'Workspace for '+(project.name||project.title||project.id)+'.':'Choose a project from the portfolio dashboard.';const stats=document.createElement('p');stats.textContent=tasks.length+' shared tasks · '+open+' open · '+done+' done';content.append(p,stats);}else if(sec==='Tasks'){const tasks=api.getState('tasks')||[];const list=document.createElement('div');list.className='t4-list';tasks.forEach(t=>{const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='t4-task';const title=document.createElement('strong');title.textContent=t.title||'(untitled)';const owner=document.createElement('span');owner.textContent=t.owner||'Unassigned';const status=document.createElement('span');status.className='t4-pill';status.textContent=t.status||'—';row.append(title,owner,status);list.append(row);});if(!tasks.length){const e=document.createElement('p');e.className='t4-empty';e.textContent='No tasks yet.';list.append(e);}content.append(list);}else{const values=noteValues(project);if(values.length){values.forEach(text=>{const p=document.createElement('div');p.className='t4-note';p.textContent=text;content.append(p);});}else{const e=document.createElement('p');e.className='t4-empty';e.textContent='No notes for this project.';content.append(e);}}}tabs.forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>api.setState('workspaceSection',b.dataset.section)));render();const unsubscribe=api.subscribe(render);root.addEventListener('bci:unmount',unsubscribe,{once:true});api.log(4,'Steer 1 B consumed: TOP_TABS workspace');
